title: Words Lost in Silence
content:
Siddu remained frozen.

His mind struggled to understand what had just happened.

Finally, he looked at Sneha with genuine confusion.

"Sneha..."

"What... did you just do?"

Sneha's cheeks burned crimson.

She lowered her eyes and smiled nervously.

"It's..."

"It's the way I thank the people I love."

For a brief moment, Siddu didn't know how to respond.

Her answer only left him even more confused.

He wanted to ask another question, but instead, he quietly picked up the spoon once again.

"Your food is getting cold," he said gently.

"Finish your dinner first."

Sneha nodded with a shy smile.

The room fell silent once again.

Siddu continued feeding her patiently.

Every now and then, their eyes met.

Each time, Siddu quickly looked away, unsure why he suddenly felt so awkward.

Sneha, however, couldn't stop looking at him.

His kindness...

His patience...

The way he cared for her without expecting anything in return...

Every little gesture made her heart fall even deeper in love.

Soon, dinner was over.

Siddu smiled.

"There..."

"Now you should take proper care of your hand."

Sneha nodded.

"I will."

She slowly stood up.

"I'll bring some water."

"Okay," Siddu replied with a smile.

As she walked toward the small kitchen, Siddu leaned back in his chair and closed his eyes, enjoying the peaceful silence after the long day.

Sneha poured water into two glasses.

Then she looked toward him.

He was sitting peacefully with his eyes closed.

A gentle smile rested on his face.

Her heart began racing.

She knew she couldn't keep hiding her feelings any longer.

If she didn't tell him today...

She might never have the courage again.

Taking a deep breath, she gathered every ounce of courage hidden inside her heart.

"Siddu..."

"The day I met you on that train..."

"I never imagined you would become this important to me."

"Every moment I've spent with you has become one of the happiest memories of my life."

She smiled softly.

"I don't know when friendship became love."

"It just happened."

"I know your heart was once broken."

"I know you're still carrying the pain of your past."

"But..."

"If you let me..."

"I want to heal every broken piece of your heart."

"I promise..."

"I'll always stand beside you."

"I'll always be loyal to you."

"I'll never let you feel alone again."

Tears slowly gathered in her eyes.

For the first time...

She spoke the words her heart had been hiding for so long.

"I love you, Siddu."

Silence.

She waited.

One second...

Two seconds...

Five seconds...

There was no reply.

Her hopeful smile slowly faded.

"Siddu...?"

Still no answer.

Confused, she slowly walked toward him.

She stopped beside his chair.

Only then did she notice the earbuds resting in his ears.

Soft music was playing.

He was completely lost in his own world.

He hadn't heard...

A single word.

Sneha stood there speechless.

For a brief moment, she simply looked at him.

Then a helpless smile appeared on her face.

"So..."

"My first confession..."

"Ended before it even reached you."

She gently placed the glasses of water on the table beside him.

After standing there for a few more seconds, she quietly returned to her seat, carrying both the disappointment of an unanswered confession and the relief that she hadn't been rejected.

Outside...

The cold night of Jammu remained silent.

The moon watched over the sleeping city.

And somewhere within that silence...

It became the only witness...

To the love Siddu had never heard.
